segments.name: Reporting Segment
segments.description: Owns and operates open-air grocery-anchored community and neighborhood shopping centers that lease space to retail tenants.
segments.evidence: Our principal business is the ownership and operation of open-air retail shopping centers.

revenueModel.text: Tenants pay contractual monthly base rent under signed or commenced leases for space in the company's shopping centers.
revenueModel.evidence: ABR represents contractual monthly base rent as of a specified date, under leases that have been signed or commenced as of the specified date, multiplied by 12.
